description.value: When one is destroyed, it stands back up at the start of your next turn with half its maximum Hit Points. Each Afflicted can be restored this way only once per casting.

cinderfall.incomplete: This clause is an ongoing effect targeting a different creature's roll/HP/condition/behavior, sourced from the holder's own passive (P-CROSSCREATURE), with no selector anywhere in pf2e-source for one actor's rule element to reach into a separate actor on an ongoing basis. No selector for "when a specific different creature would be destroyed, revive it."
